Protection against digital threats

The Circosta Law Firm provides strategic legal assistance in cyber crime, a field that increasingly affects individuals, companies and institutions worldwide. We handle cases of:

  • online fraud;
  • data breaches;
  • identity theft;
  • hacking;
  • digital copyright violations.

We ensure a solid defense and effective protection.

International presence

What sets us apart is our international presence. With established connections in Europe, the Middle East, the Americas, Asia and Africa, we can operate across jurisdictions, offering rapid intervention and incisive strategies. This global reach allows us to follow cases that go beyond national borders, where cyber threats often expand.

Litigation and preventive advice

We represent clients in both criminal and civil proceedings, while also providing preventive consultancy in compliance, risk management and data protection.

Our mission is to ensure that digital innovation does not become a source of vulnerability, but an opportunity safeguarded by law.
